blocks.text: WorldBoundsDef = { bottom?: number | false // The lowest y (meters, feet position) a character or vehicle may reach before the engine treats it as fallen out of the world. Crossing it fires the body's `onOutOfBounds` hook once per excursion and (unless a hook returns `false` to own the response) teleports the body back to the event's `respawnPoint`. Unauthored, every 3D place has one, 64 m under the lowest floor it offers: a heightmap's lowest ground built here (never above the `verticalRange` floor − 64 m), a voxel volume's floor, or: with no terrain floor (`terrain: off`, nothing installed), the spawn point, never above −64 m: that place's ground is the game's own geometry, and a body past every floor comes back instead of dropping forever. A 2d-side place has one too, 64 m under its spawn point, never above −64 m (its ground is the colliders you build); 2d-top has none unless you author one (nothing falls along y there). `false` removes the default: below-bound space falls forever (`ctx.place.worldBounds.bottom = false`). A value, never `null`: the place funnel deletes null at every depth, so a null here would re-expose the default it meant to remove. }
